title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E03 — Hagrid's Challenge
James and Oliver Phelps challenge the teams to recreate edible magical creatures featuring ingredients that could be foraged in the Forbidden Forest.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E17 — Beat the Boss!
Ross Matthews and podcaster Jaymee Sire recruit crew members Matt Skrincosky and Allison Cancro in a unified bid to finally take down their formidable boss, Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E10 — Are We Having Fun Yet?
Carson Kressley teams up with Triple Threat titan Ayesha Nurdjaja as chefs Laurence Louie and Logan Sandoval put Bobby Flay to the test with a dish he's never heard of.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S38 E06 — Fight Like a Lion
Eric Adjepong and Jaymee Sire team up with chefs Solomon Johnson and Niema Digrazia to challenge Bobby Flay with a dish from the African Diaspora.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S35 E04 — Don't Yuck My Yum
Sunny Anderson and TV host Ross Mathews team up with chefs Kaleena Bliss and Melissa Donahue-Talmadge to boil up a win against Bobby Flay.

title: Kitchen Undercover
description:
S01 E05 — Steakhouse Stakeout
Ralph, a successful nightclub owner, thought running Buena Mesa steakhouse would be easy; now, Chef Antonia Lofaso sends her sous-chef Nestor Milian undercover to save a filthy, failing restaurant before everything falls apart.

title: Kitchen Undercover
description:
S01 E04 — Mission: ImPASTAble
Landmark Italian restaurant Ricci's is on the brink. Overwhelmed new owner Edith asks Chef Lofaso and her undercover sous-chef Nestor Milian to expose the chaos before an authentic Italian nonna puts its food, and reputation, to the ultimate test.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E06 — Alex vs Fruit
Welcoming three chefs to challenge Alex in a battle for the best fruit dish using ingredients that can give them an advantage with the judges.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E07 — Alex vs Japan
Eric invites three Japanese chefs to take on Alex in a competition that's out of her comfort zone; judges Shota Nakajima and Tetsu Yahagi decide if they have what it takes to beat an Iron Chef in her own arena.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E08 — Alex vs Eggs
Welcoming three chefs to use their skills with eggs to crack Alex's competition prowess; in a blind judging, Brooke Williamson and Michael Voltaggio.

title: Alex vs. America
description:
S04 E03 — Alex vs Frozen Desserts
Eric Adjepong challenges three cool treat chefs to take on Alex; Duff Goldman and Natasha Case judge as the chefs try to keep their cool to beat Alex.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E02 — Ted's Takeover
Ted is in charge of the baskets; in the first round, he challenges the chefs with a wildly unusual product in a tube and his favorite snack of all time; the final basket includes an exotic extract and an Italian dessert that Ted can never pass up.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E06 — Indigenous Inspiration
Native American chefs who revere indigenous culinary traditions compete in a first-of-its-kind battle; every basket is packed with ingredients known and loved in native communities, like sumac and whitefish for the first round.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E03 — Venison Valor
An over-reduced sauce and undercooked venison are potential problems in the first round; with Mexican chocolate in the dessert basket, it seems like the judges are in for a treat; one of the chef's time management woes are worrying.

title: Chopped
description:
S64 E05 — Eggscuse Me
The chef who cracks the code on this special competition's egg-centric baskets will win $10,000; delicate eggs and smoked seafood are part of the appetizer round challenge; the finalists find a giant egg in the dessert basket.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S10 E09 — Thanks but No Thanksgiving
Martha Stewart joins Chopped judge Scott Conant for a Thanksgiving challenge; Moroccan-born Omar Zerrei and former Iron Chef America sous chef Ed Cotton take on Bobby Flay.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S14 E04 — Turkey's Done
There's a lot to be thankful for when Food Network's Sunny Anderson and Bobby Flay's daughter Sophie is in the house; silent but deadly Clayton Chapman and Italian authority Tony Priolo battle it out for the chance to stuff Bobby like a turkey.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S18 E07 — Stuffed With Victory
Geoffrey Zakarian and Sara Haines have a lot to be thankful for this year; they bring in Creole Chef Bernard Carmouche and meatball master Daniel Sharp to stuff Bobby Flay like a turkey.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S22 E10 — Gobble Till You Wobble
Iron Chef Alex Guarnaschelli and comedian Jay Pharoah look to gobble up a victory over Bobby Flay as chefs Jason Bissell and Tirzah Love face off.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S25 E17 — All About That Baste
Bobby has a full house for Thanksgiving when he's joined by Damaris Phillips and "Man v. Food" host Casey Webb; chefs Kevin Grossi and Lindsay Porter want a second helping of victory.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S05 E01 — Holiday Throwdown: There's No Place Like Ham
Bobby and Brooke Williamson welcome guest chefs Damaris Phillips and Viet Pham to kick off the holiday chaos with a spirited game of Spin the Bottle; things get even smokier as the kitchen heats up for a festive, flavor-packed holiday ham showdown.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S05 E02 — Holiday Throwdown: Swim with the Fishes
Guest chefs Tiffani Faison and Gabe Bertaccini dive headfirst into Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson's holiday madness with a chaotic game of Find the Pickle; then, the teams face off in a high-stakes Feast of the Seven Fishes cook-off.

title: Tournament of Champions: All-Star Christmas
description:
S02 E03 — Deck the Halls...of the TOC Arena
Guy Fieri continues the holiday festivities with the last three first-round battles; TOC champ Mei Lin and pastry wiz Alex Stupak battle the wild and crazy duo of chefs Brian Malarkey and Carlos Anthony.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S41 E16 — Bobby's BFFs
Bobby Flay's nearest and dearest, Brooke Williamson and Damaris Phillips, call on chefs Allyson Harvie and Christina Miros to challenge him with a dish he'll never forget.

description:
S39 E07 — Oh, Crepe!
Brooke Williamson and actor Randall Park recruit chefs Marcos Spaziani and Richard Van Lê to teach Bobby Flay a thing or two about a tricky signature dish.

title: Beat Bobby Flay
description:
S33 E07 — The Bald and the Beautiful
Supermodel and swimwear designer Devon Windsor teams up with Chef Michael Symon to keep the drama high while chefs Dom Crisp and Santiago Guzzetti try to cook up a win against Bobby Flay.

title: Inogen Portable Oxygen - No More Tanks!
description: Regain independence and enjoy greater mobility with the compact design and long-lasting battery of portable oxygen.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S11 E05 — Fall Into Brunch!
Marcela makes pumpkin French toast casserole; The Kitchen gang competes in a breakfast edition of Tool Takedown; Katie Lee makes breakfast nachos with a waffle base; Food Network Star winner Tregaye Fraser shares her savory bacon breakfast cupcakes.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S15 E05 — Friendsgiving Feast
The Kitchen hosts a star-studded Friendsgiving feast; Sunny Anderson's "Sunny, who pecanned my bird" bird; homemade green bean casserole; "dressed up" mac and cheese; lemon pecan slab pie; edible Thanksgiving centerpieces; gobble gobble punch.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S26 E07 — No-Rules-Giving
Bacon wrapped turkey breast with "stuffing" croutons; Cornish game hens and veggie holiday cheat sheet; twice-baked sweet potatoes with sausage and ricotta; Thanksgiving chimichanga; Thanksgiving sundae duo; frozen apple pie margarita.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E01 — Inaugural Food Fight
Guy Fieri kicks off the competition with chefs Angelo Sosa, Kayla Pfeiffer, and Trimell Hawkins; the chefs must bring bold flavors to judges Maneet Chauhan and Graham Elliot for a chance to win up to $20,000 and continue their run through Flavortown.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E02 — No Utensils Day
The returning champ faces Maria Mazon and Brad Miller as Guy Fieri challenges the chefs to make only handheld food; judges Adam Sobel and Tiffani Faison choose which chef adapted best to the unexpected twists of Guy's culinary wonderland.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E03 — Pork Day
Guy challenges the reigning champ to battle chefs Tiana Gee and Andrew Riccatelli to bring home the bacon with bold pork dishes; Stephanie Izard and Graham Elliot judge every bite to decide which chef will hog the spotlight and win up to $20,000.

title: Flavortown Food Fight
description:
S01 E04 — Crunch Day
Mayor Guy Fieri is calling it Crunch Day in Flavortown; the returning winner faces off against chefs Josh Smith and Saba Duffy to impress judges Troy Johnson and Viet Pham with mind-blowingly crunchy bites worthy of scoring up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S15 E04 — GGG Gives Thanks
Up-and-coming chefs make a Thanksgiving feast using only the ingredients they can fit in a traditional cornucopia basket; prepare a fall staple using a list of the Fieri family's favorite ingredients.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S19 E06 — Family Food Feud Thanksgiving
Two families return for a Thanksgiving family showdown; Guy has a member of each family pick from unidentified cans for the featured ingredient in their first meal; a family member must make a fall favorite using five pounds of ingredients.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S19 E08 — Judges' Thanksgiving Throwdown
Four all-star chefs are ready to prove that it's possible to make Thanksgiving dinner with limited ingredients and then use the leftovers to make a different meal the next day; one chef will claim the title of All-Star Thanksgiving Throwdown champ.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S22 E08 — DDD Thanksgiving
Guy kicks things off by having the DDD chefs make their ultimate Thanksgiving sandwich without shopping in a crucial aisle; the chefs must make a dish under Guy's designated weight limit.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S22 E09 — Guy's Thanksgiving Games
Guy gives the chefs an empty cornucopia to use while shopping for their two signature Thanksgiving sides; the chefs have to make a classic Thanksgiving meal on a budget while also featuring a special ingredient determined by Guy's wheel of chance.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S31 E01 — Fieri Thanksgiving Party
The three youngest members of the Fieri family are paired up with all-star chefs to prepare a one-hour Thanksgiving feast; Guy Fieri gives them a two-for-one special of pie and turkey that they must use in both their appetizer and entrée.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E03 — Hagrid's Challenge
James and Oliver Phelps challenge the teams to recreate edible magical creatures featuring ingredients that could be foraged in the Forbidden Forest.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E04 — The Dark Arts Challenge
James and Oliver challenge the teams to create showpieces inspired by Professors of Defense Against the Dark Arts; Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain are joined by guest judge Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto in the Defense Against the Dark Arts classroom.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E04 — Chocolate for the Win
Jesse Palmer asks the nine remaining bakers to create amazing chocolate chip cookie holiday desserts using Ghirardelli chocolate chips; the best dessert is selected by judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh to win a $1,000 prize package.

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S02 E03 — Holiday: Christmas Carolers' Tavern
Host Peck welcomes three Christmas carolers to a historic holiday tavern, where they hunt for six hyperrealistic cakes created by baker April Julian and disguised as everyday objects; can the singing trio end on a high note and win up to $12,000?

title: Sweet Deceit
description:
S02 E04 — Holiday: Yuletide Toy Store
Host Josh Peck and cake artist Jose Barajas welcome three busy moms who are expert holiday shoppers; their gift-giving know-how is put to the test as they try to spot the hyperrealistic sweets hidden around a festive holiday toy store to win $12,000!

title: Chopped
description:
S57 E06 — Grand Champs' Holiday Hurrah
Four Grand Champions are headed home to the Chopped kitchen for the holidays; the chefs are challenged with some extremely tough baskets, beginning with a kooky candy cane in the appetizer round.

title: Chopped
description:
S58 E12 — Abalone Absurdities
The chefs are shocked when abalone appears in their appetizer baskets; a fusion soup and a colorful veggie are in the entrée basket, and an unwelcome egg is in the dessert basket.

title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
description:
S01 E04 — Holiday Feast
Host Wells Adams asks the empires to create hyperrealistic cakes that look like a holiday feast but taste like a decadent dessert; the teams that deliver both illusion and flavor for the judges continue their empire's reign.

title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
description:
S01 E05 — North Pole Animals
Host Wells Adams challenges the baking teams to create towering showpieces of iconic North Pole animals, like polar bears, walrus and snow owls; judges Yolanda Gampp and Jacques Torres are looking for scale, accuracy and cozy, warm flavors.

title: Sweet Empire: Winter Wars
description:
S01 E06 — Finale
In a final showdown, host Wells Adams gives the bakers complete creative freedom to build an entire edible world that celebrates the holiday season; only one empire rises above the rest to claim the $50,000 prize and the crown of Sweet Empire.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E04 — Reindeer's New Hobby
The six remaining teams face off as Jeff challenges them to envision a hobby for Santa's reindeer to enjoy when they aren't pulling the sleigh; Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira judge the designs before flying one team home.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E05 — Ugly Sweater Party
Jeff Mauro challenges the five remaining teams to create a woodland creature that is throwing an ugly sweater party for all its forest friends; at the end of the festive fiesta, judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira eliminate one more team.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E06 — Time Travelin' Santa
Jeff Mauro and the Holiday Wars time machine send the remaining four teams back in time; each group must create a Santa from a specific period in history; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide who will move forward.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E07 — A Very Peanuts Christmas Tree
Jeff Mauro invites the remaining teams to create a Christmas tree featuring Charles Schulz's beloved Peanuts characters; two teams will face off in the finale for a trip to Iceland.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S04 E08 — North Pole Talent Show
Santa throws a North Pole talent show and the final two teams showcase the secret talents of the town's brave residents; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira crown the champion.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S04 E01 — Holiday Throwdown: Friendsgiving Potluck
Sunny Anderson kicks off the holiday season with a Friendsgiving takedown unlike anything Bobby Flay's ever seen; chefs Damaris Phillips, Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso are serving up festive dishes with a heaping side of revenge.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S05 E02 — Holiday Throwdown: Swim with the Fishes
Guest chefs Tiffani Faison and Gabe Bertaccini dive headfirst into Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson's holiday madness with a chaotic game of Find the Pickle; then, the teams face off in a high-stakes Feast of the Seven Fishes cook-off.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S05 E01 — Holiday Throwdown: There's No Place Like Ham
Bobby and Brooke Williamson welcome guest chefs Damaris Phillips and Viet Pham to kick off the holiday chaos with a spirited game of Spin the Bottle; things get even smokier as the kitchen heats up for a festive, flavor-packed holiday ham showdown.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E05 — Snowed in Sweets
Jesse Palmer asks the teams to make desserts representing snow-day activities for judges Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown; the most recent winning team gets to choose either a 15-minute head start or stealing a baker from the other team!

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E06 — Jingle Mingle
Jesse Palmer asks the seven bakers to make a Chrismukkah dessert platter with decorated Christmas cookies, rugelach, and traditional Hanukkah sufganiyot; Judges Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown do a blind tasting to decide who wins.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E07 — Retro Christmas
In the semifinals, there are no more teams; Jesse Palmer gives the six remaining bakers a gauntlet of three retro Christmas dessert challenges; guest judge Stephanie Boswell joins Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown to decide which bakers go to the finale.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S12 E08 — Naughty & Nice Christmas
For the finale, Jesse Palmer challenges the bakers to make large-scale, over-the-top naughty vs. nice cakes; guest judge Zac Young joins Nancy Fuller and Kardea Brown to decide the winner of $25,000.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E04 — Freak Show of Funnel Cakes
Noah samples funnel cakes from across the country; a funnel cake sundae in Ohio; a maple syrup-drenched funnel-fried bacon in Georgia; funnel cakes featuring pumpkin in Kentucky; apples in Pennsylvania; nacho cheese and jalapeños in California.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E06 — Say Cheese!
Noah dives into some of the cheesiest dishes, both savory and sweet; deep-fried mac and cheese at the Calgary Stampede in Canada; Cowboy Pistolettes in Texas; classic cheese curds in Wisconsin; bacon-covered New York cheesecake.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S24 E10 — Smoked, Grilled and Fried
In Miami, wild boar sausage and house-cured bacon; in Modesto, Calif., tacos and a sweet and savory waffle; in Stockton, Calif., an ex-NFL player slinging wings that score with the sauce.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S25 E08 — Burgers, Buns and Bagels
Guy visits an amped-up deli serving up lamb burgers and ribs; a Koreatown favorite loads up Asian buns and a unique bacon-corn bar dish; a world-class bagel shop spices up their specialty and tops things off with Jersey's famous pork roll.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S25 E06 — Sausage, Seafood and Shawarma
A family pizza-making tradition; griot, snapper and octopus; a spin on street food from around the world.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S26 E08 — From North to South America
Guy Fieri's digs into flavors spanning the Americas; in Charlotte, N.C., a brewery serves the bomb bacon jam burger and a duck confit flatbread; in Cancun, Mexico, a spot serves street tacos; in Houston, a joint cooks up Argentinian empanadas.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S26 E10 — Wonder Women
Guy Fieri tries an all-female lineup; a grandma cooks family recipes like homemade tamales and chile rellenos with a twist in Houston; a spot that makes meatball masterpieces in Orlando, Fla.; a bakery making sweet and savory specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E07 — A Passport of Flavor
In Lansing, shawarma and grape leaves; a Vietnamese barbecue spot serves spring rolls and smokes brisket banh mi; in San Antonio, an authentic Mexican bakery goes old school with their sandwich sourdough and tequila croissants.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E03 — Barbecue, Batter and Beer Can Chicken
Ramen and beer can chicken in Maui; in Los Angeles, a food truck puts a twist on fish and chips; a downtown barbecue spot smokes up the belly and fries up the chicken.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E01 — Mom's Kitchen
Guy Fieri grabs grub straight out of Mom's kitchen; in Boulder, Colo., a mother-son team serve up dan dan noodles and steamed buns; in Columbus, Ohio, a Jamaican joint dishes out jerk chicken; in Arizona, a family spot cooks Latin cuisine.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E17 — East Coast, West Coast
A Palo Alto, Calif., joint serves spicy pork and knockout gnocchi; a bakery-restaurant in Wilmington, N.C., makes major meatloaf and fries up French toast with a fantastic twist; a Puerto Rican party spot in Oakland, Calif., mixes it up with mofongo.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S29 E02 — Sandwiches, Southern and South of the Border
Guy Fieri dives into sandwiches, Southern eats and south-of-the-border specialties; in Spokane, Wash., a lights-out food truck smoking up real-deal barbecue; in Ashland, Ore., a Mexican joint putting a tasty twist on tamales.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: A for Amped-Up Eats
Fieri's diving into amped-up eats that are sure to satisfy. A coastal Georgia joint is putting its spin on Nashville hot chicken with a side of spicy shrimp, while a Vietnamese noodle bar in Calgary is dishing out scratch-made savory street food.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: B for Big-Bite Brunch
Guy Fieri's going from the-bomb breakfast to a taste of Italy! He hits up a brunch bonanza in Columbus, OH, with decadent dulce de leche pancake balls, elevated eats in Boston like rock star rum baba and punchy Parmesan pasta in San Luis Obispo, CA.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: C for Cheesy Crowd-Pleasers
Fieri's getting cheesy and meaty, starting at a South Bound Brook, NJ, meat market stacking up their spin on the sloppy joe. In Nashville,a taco joint is piling nachos with hot local flavor, and a down-home spot is serving the bomb barbecue pork mac.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: D for Daring Dishes
Guy Fieri's digging into some surprising ingredients, from lamb neck in Santa Fe, NM, to duck tongue tacos in Kansas City, MO.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: E for Elevated Everyday Favorites
Guy dives into a serious beef bonanza with scratch-made meaty ravioli in Delaware, an elevated spin on the French dip in San Diego and beefed-up Middle-Eastern fare in El Paso, Texas.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: F for Funky Food Finds
Guy Fieri's grabbing all kinds of funky flavor, starting in Laramie, WY, where a restaurant-bar is pilin' up their nachos, and a longtime spot is cooking up a vegetarian banh mi. Then, a Mexican joint in Alaska is serving dynamite duck tacos.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
A-Z: G for Guilty-Pleasure Grub
Guy Fieri dives into all kinds of comfort cooking. In Phoenix, he visits a funky joint that's stacking up barbecue fries and putting a new spin on chilaquiles. In Colorado, he stops by a pizza place that's loading up the pies.
